- Signed W-8/W-9 are not applicable for EU vendor but please indicate if you have any US withholding status for cross-border services (not expected here).

We need to know the exact invoice-to entity label we expose to the supplier so their SDI routing and VAT treatment are correct. Also flag whether we want to apply PO-level tax overrides in the ERP mapping.

Elena — once Procurement confirms the billing entity we can provide a short mapping spec (XML example + PO placement) and target a PO activation within 3 business days.
